inlineSvgPreview.gallery.include.markdownDescription: Glob patterns (relative to the workspace folder) for the files the SVG Gallery shows, e.g. `["src/**/icons.tsx"]`. Does not affect inline previews, which show in every file.

inlineSvgPreview.gallery.exclude.markdownDescription: Glob patterns or folders to leave out of the SVG Gallery, e.g. `["src/legacy"]`. Does not affect inline previews.

inlineSvgPreview.currentColor.markdownDescription: Color used for `currentColor` in SVG previews. `auto` picks a light color on dark themes and a dark color on light themes. Any CSS color works (e.g. `#ffffff`, `tomato`). Leave empty to disable (renders black, like a plain image).

inlineSvgPreview.applyColorToFill.markdownDescription: Also use `#inlineSvgPreview.currentColor#` as the default fill for shapes with no `fill` set (they otherwise render black). SVGs that set their own `fill` or `color` on the root element are left unchanged.
